title: PedDx: An End-to-End Deep Learning Framework for Pediatric Posterior Fossa Tumor Diagnosis with Agentic AI–Enabled Independent External Evaluation
summary: Results report five-class accuracy of 81.4% in the external CHOA cohort (88.7% among non-abstained cases) and 92.5% across 40 independently processed WCH cases (97.3% among non-abstained cases); WCH contained only three histologies, and the preprint also reports confidently incorrect OOD cases. Methods describe a frozen pretrained 3DINO backbone, multi-crop MRI sampling, calibrated class probabilities and confidence-based abstention; the deployed workflow also includes a quality-control agent. Testing: Methods/results distinguish discovery (n=492), replication (n=114), external CHOA (n=129) and independent WCH workflow cases (n=40), with pathology/clinical diagnoses and stated exclusions. The independent cohorts support the narrow diagnostic-performance result; small WCH sample, missing two histologies, unreviewed preprint and no evidence of improved patient outcomes limit interpretation.. Independent external evaluation of a pediatric posterior-fossa tumor MRI classifier and full workflow reports performance on separate CHOA and WCH cohorts; bounded to diagnostic classification, not clinical benefit. Source affiliation was not stated in the reviewed case checks and was unavailable in the local bibliographic cache.
